description: This PHP source file defines a command class `CacheClearCommand` for clearing specific cache namespaces in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base command class and implements logic to clear caches for predefined namespaces, providing success or failure messages.

classes.name: CacheClearCommand
classes.description: A command class for clearing specific cache namespaces within the OrangeHRM application.
